xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4677: Fly remote smoke test (PAN-4295)

narratives.Problem: PAN-4295 needs a live end-to-end Fly remote run. This throwaway issue gives the remote work agent a trivial, verifiable change to commit, push and open a PR for.
narratives.Proposal: Append the single line 'Fly remote smoke test for PAN-4295' to docs/fly-smoke.txt (creating it), commit with an Item trailer, push. The PR is closed unmerged afterwards.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not change any file other than docs/fly-smoke.txt (planning artifacts under .pan/ excepted)
- Do not add tests
- Do not touch Fly remote source code; that is PAN-4295's own work
- Do not add the file to any docs index, Mintlify navigation or README
- Do not merge the PR

autoDecisions.summary: Exactly one xBRIEF item that also serves as the documentation item
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue body states 'One xBRIEF item, no tests, no other files'; the file lives under docs/, which satisfies the docs gate.
Appending creates the file when absent and preserves any existing content, matching 'append exactly one line (create the file if it does not exist)'.

metadata.docsJustification: The only change is the docs/fly-smoke.txt marker file; no documented behavior changes.

items.title: Append the smoke-test line to docs/fly-smoke.txt

expected_outputs: tail prints exactly: Fly remote smoke test for PAN-4295

narrative.Action: From the workspace root run: printf 'Fly remote smoke test for PAN-4295\n' >> docs/fly-smoke.txt . Commit only docs/fly-smoke.txt with the trailer 'Item: append-smoke-line' and push. Add no tests and touch no other file.

items.title: Given the pushed feature branch, when running tail -n 1 docs/fly-smoke.txt, then it prints exactly 'Fly remote smoke test for PAN-4295' and the file ends with a single newline
Given the pushed feature branch, when running git diff --numstat origin/main...HEAD -- docs/fly-smoke.txt, then it reports exactly 1 added line and 0 removed lines
Given the pushed feature branch, when running git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD -- . ':!.pan', then it returns only docs/fly-smoke.txt (no tests, no source files)
